title: CCTV to identify violent protesters after police injured and pelted with rocks at Melbourne rally
summary: Victoria police say the city has had a ‘gutful’ of protesters looking to fight with officers there to keep them separated from rivals Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Police will use an abundance of CCTV and body-worn camera footage to identify those responsible for violent protests that put two officers in hospital. One woman is expected to be charged over the ugly clashes as police tried to separate the anti-immigration rally from a counter anti-racism protest in Melbourne’s CBD on Sunday. Continue reading...
